title: Nourishing Canadian Taleggio Gratin
description: A malty, pillowy, romantic Canadian dish featuring Taleggio cheese, this gratin is a perfect comfort food for a cold winter night, made with satvik-friendly ingredients and a unique ice-bath-shock step.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the heavy cream, malted milk powder, sea salt, and black pepper, and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly, then stir in the crumbled Taleggio cheese until it is fully melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the cubed whole wheat bread to the cheese mixture and stir until the bread is fully coated.
Transfer the bread and cheese mixture to a baking dish and dot the top with the unsalted butter.
Place the baking dish in a large roasting pan and add enough hot water to the roasting pan to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake the gratin for 25 minutes, then remove it from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Submerge the baking dish in an ice bath to stop the cooking process, then remove it from the ice bath and sprinkle the top with chopped fresh thyme.
Serve the gratin hot, garnished with additional fresh thyme if desired.
